ascend_impact.functionality: GPUModelRunner 是 vllm-ascend NPUModelRunnerV2 的基类，本次变更修改了 GPUModelRunner.__init__ 中 ModelCudaGraphManager 的构造（新增 ubatch_runner 实参）、execute_model 中 UBatchRunner.prepare() 的调用（新增 cg_mode/for_capture 实参）以及 VllmConfig 对 DBO 与 CUDA graph 的互斥校验。CudaGraphManager 构造函数与 UBatchRunner.prepare 的新参数均有默认值，向后兼容；vllm-ascend 若覆写 execute_model 或使用自研 ModelAclGraphManager，则不会触发新的 DBO graph 逻辑。若 vllm-ascend 在 Ascend 上启用 DBO（ParallelConfig.use_ubatching + enable_dbo），需同步 UBatchRunner.prepare 新签名及 cg_mode 传递。VllmConfig 互斥条件放宽对 Ascend 的 ACL Graph 无直接影响。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Hard break (TypeError) at model-runner init, not just a behavioral change. The commit adds a new `ubatch_runner` keyword to the `ModelCudaGraphManager(...)` constructor call in `GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache` (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py:719-726). vllm-ascend replaces that class with `factory` in `graph_manager_wrapper` (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:856-884), and the factory's signature `factory(vllm_config, device, cudagraph_mode, decode_query_len, lora_capture_cases=None, varlen_decode=False)` does not accept `ubatch_runner`, so every MRV2 init with CUDA graphs enabled will raise `TypeError: factory() got an unexpected keyword argument 'ubatch_runner'`. Required changes: (1) In `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py`, add `ubatch_runner: Any = None` to the `factory` signature and pass it through to `ModelAclGraphManager(...)`. (2) In `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py`, add `ubatch_runner: Any = None` to `ModelAclGraphManager.__init__` and forward it to `super().__init__(...)`. Since DBO is disabled on Ascend (`enable_dbo`/`ubatch_size` reset in `vllm_ascend/platform.py`), `self.ubatch_runner` is always `None`, so no DBO capture logic (UBatchRunner.begin_capturable_run/abort_pending_run, `_maybe_ubatch_twin`, `_capture_stream`) is ever exercised; only signature compatibility is needed. The `dp_utils.sync_cudagraph_and_dp_padding` ubatch branch is guarded by `allow_ubatching` (False on Ascend) and requires no change. Verify with `pytest -sv tests/ut/` and a basic MRV2 CUDA-graph smoke test.
deep_analysis.risk: High if unaddressed: `NPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache` → `super().initialize_kv_cache()` → `ModelCudaGraphManager(...)` (patched to `factory`) will throw `TypeError` on every Ascend run with CUDA graph capture enabled (the default), breaking all MRV2 serving. Once the factory and `ModelAclGraphManager.__init__` accept/forward the `ubatch_runner` kwarg (default None), risk drops to negligible because DBO remains disabled on Ascend and the new microbatched-graph code paths are unreachable.
